--- page 10 ---
MAZDA CONNECT™1 | Keeping you connected to your music, entertainment,
friends or colleagues—all while keeping your eyes focused on the road—the CX-3 is
as intuitive as they come. Carefully placed at the optimum position, the multifunction
Commander control on the center console lets you navigate the options displayed on
your full-color center display. It’s impressive technology that invigorates the senses,
keeping you in close touch no matter how far you travel.
BLUETOOTH® | PANDORA® | HD RADIO™2 | TWITTER | SiriusXM3
1 Don’t drive while distracted. Even with voice commands, only use MAZDA CONNECT™/other devices when safe.
Some features may be locked out while the vehicle is in motion. Not all features are compatible with all phones.
Message and data rates may apply. 2 Available feature. 3 Available feature. SiriusXM Satellite Radio reception
requires a subscription and Mazda satellite radio. See full disclaimer in Specifications.

--- page 15 ---
SPECIFICATIONS
ENGINE
SKYACTIV®-G 2.0L 4-cylinder engine
146 horsepower @ 6,000 rpm
146 lb-ft of torque @ 2,800 rpm
TRANSMISSION AND DRIVETRAIN
SKYACTIV-Drive 6-speed automatic transmission
with manual shift and Sport modes
SKYACTIV-VEHICLE DYNAMICS with G-Vectoring Control
Front-wheel drive (standard)
i-ACTIV AWD® all-wheel drive (available)
Hill Launch Assist1
FUEL ECONOMY
EPA-estimated MPG (city/highway)2
29/34 (FWD)
27/32 (AWD)
FUEL CAPACITY (U.S. gallons)
12.7 (FWD)
11.9 (AWD)
DIMENSIONS
Overall length (in) 168.3
Wheelbase (in) 101.2
Width (in) 69.6
Height (in) 60.7 (Sport)/60.9 (Touring and Grand Touring)
CARGO CAPACITY (cu ft)
Without Bose® audio
12.4 (rear seatbacks up) / 44.5 (rear seatbacks down)
With Bose® audio
10.1 (rear seatbacks up) / 42.3 (rear seatbacks down)
1 Hill Launch Assist is an auxiliary device that assists the driver in accelerating from a stop while
on a slope. It is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. There are limitations to the system.
Please see your Owner’s Manual for details. 2 EPA-estimated mileage. Actual results will vary.
